meta.title: Scope Creep Guard
meta.description: Check whether a new client request fits your agreed project scope, and reply with confidence.

auth.heroDescription: Save what you agreed, check new requests, and prepare a reply for your client.
auth.registerDescription: Create an account to save your projects and checks.
auth.verifyDescription: Confirm your email address before opening your workspace.
auth.mail_accepted: Your confirmation email was accepted for sending. Check your inbox and spam folder.
auth.mail_failed: Your account is saved, but the email could not be sent. You can request another email.
auth.mail_unknown: Your account is saved. We cannot confirm whether the last email was sent. Check your inbox or request another email.
auth.mail_not_attempted: Your account is saved. Request a confirmation email to continue.
auth.resendCountdown: You can request another email in {seconds} seconds.
auth.signOutAndSignIn: Sign out and use another account
auth.confirmDescription: Use the button below to confirm the address associated with this link.
auth.confirmedDescription: The email address associated with this link has been confirmed.
auth.confirmedSignIn: Sign in to the confirmed account to continue. Your current browser identity has not been changed.
auth.newLinkHelp: If this link has expired or was already used, sign in to request a new one.
auth.requestNewLink: Sign in and request a new email
auth.resetDescription: Set a new password for the account associated with this link.
auth.recoveryNeutral: If an account exists for this address, a recovery email will be sent.
auth.passwordChangedDescription: Sign in with your new password. Your previous sessions and recovery links have been revoked.
auth.recoverySessionNotice: You are signed in as {email}. This link applies only to its original account. Sign out explicitly to sign in again.

projects.title: Projects
projects.description: Each project holds one agreed scope you check requests against.
projects.emptyDescription: Add a project to get started.
projects.endDateError: Enter an end date on or after the start date.
projects.newDescription: Save the agreed scope once — then check every future request against it.
projects.scopePlaceholder: Paste the deliverables, revision rounds, and exclusions here…
projects.scopeTip: Include deliverables, revision rounds, and anything outside the agreement.
projects.uploadHint: Accepts .txt, .md, or text-based .pdf up to 5 MB and 200 PDF pages. Extracted text is limited to 100,000 characters and stays editable; files are not stored.
projects.deleteDescription: The project will leave Projects and Drafts. Its saved checks and agreements will remain available in History.
projects.deleteFailed: Could not archive the project. Try again.
projects.termsChanged: Project terms changed. Run the scope check again to create a new analysis and draft.
projects.pagesWithoutText: No text was found on pages: {pages}. Review the extracted scope.
projects.nulRemoved: Null characters were removed. Review the extracted text.
projects.confirmLeave: Leave this form and discard unsaved changes?

history.title: History
history.selectProject: Select a project to see its check history.
history.emptyDescription: Completed checks will appear here. Your working edits stay in Drafts.
history.archivedHelp: This project is archived. Saved checks and agreements are available here for reference.
history.archivesFailed: Archived projects could not be loaded.
history.savedDraftFailed: Could not load the saved version. Try again.
history.listHelp: Open a project to view its details, saved checks and agreements.
history.restoreFailed: Could not restore the project. Please try again.

check.noProjectDescription: Add a project to get started.
check.noScopeTitle: This project has no saved scope yet.
check.noScopeDescription: Add the deliverables and exclusions from your contract or SOW so requests can be compared against them.
check.requestPlaceholder: Paste the message or request your client just sent…
check.openaiNotice: Checking sends this project's scope and your request text to OpenAI for analysis. Review the result before sending anything to your client.

result.loading: Comparing the request against your scope…
result.errorDescription: Something went wrong while checking this request. Your scope and the request text are still saved — just try again.
result.shortScopeTitle: Your scope is too short to judge
result.shortScopeDescription: There isn't enough detail in the saved scope to compare this request reliably. Add the deliverables, revision rounds, and exclusions from your contract, proposal, or SOW, then check again.
result.preliminaryEstimate: Preliminary analysis estimate. Agreement terms are set separately and may differ.
result.verifyWarning: This is an AI-assisted assessment, not a legal or final decision. Review it before you reply to your client.
result.completeProjectTerms: Complete project terms to create Change Order
result.changeOrderError: Could not prepare an estimate. Try again.
result.clientLanguageHint: Detected: {language}. Choose the language for replies and the Change Order.
result.clientLanguageUncertain: The request language is unclear. We used your interface language; choose the client language if needed.
result.confirmClientLanguage: Changing the language will translate and replace your edited client materials. Continue?
result.clientLanguageError: Could not update client materials. Your analysis and estimate are unchanged.
result.supportedClientLanguages: The language applies to all replies and the Change Order. The analysis stays in your interface language.
result.clientLanguageStorageWarning: The language was updated, but browser storage is unavailable. It cannot be restored after a refresh.

reply.heading: Suggested reply to client
reply.regenerateError: Couldn’t generate a new variant. Your reply was not changed. Try again.
reply.sendYourself: You send it yourself — nothing is sent automatically.
reply.confirmReplace: Switching tone will replace your edits to this reply. Continue?

readiness.help: This draft is incomplete. Review the highlighted fields before sending or finalizing. Your edits are kept; Copy and PDF mark missing information.
readiness.positive: Enter a positive number with up to two decimal places for {field}. Choose No additional charge for free work.

changeOrder.noAdditionalChargeHint: Use this when you deliberately choose to perform the out-of-scope work for free.
changeOrder.error: Copy or download failed. Please try again.
changeOrder.heading: Change order draft
changeOrder.legalNotice: This document is a draft to help you start the conversation — it is not legal advice. Review and adapt it before sending.
changeOrder.pdfLanguageUnsupported: PDF export supports Latin, Cyrillic and Greek text. Choose a supported client language or replace unsupported characters before exporting.

examples.inText: On the Home page, could you fix the typo in the hero headline and adjust the accent color to a slightly darker blue? This would be part of our revision round.
examples.borderlineText: Could you add a small newsletter sign-up section to the bottom of the Home page? It is a new element, but it sits on a page that is already in scope.
examples.outText: Can you also add 3 more pages, prepare mobile versions of all the pages, and do a second round of revisions after we review?

workspace.loadingDescription: Fetching your private projects and history.
workspace.footer: Scope Creep Guard stores projects and history in your authenticated workspace. Scope analysis uses OpenAI. Verdicts are AI-assisted suggestions, not legal advice.

drafts.title: My drafts
drafts.description: Saved requests and documents across all your projects.

onboarding.step0Body: Create a project to keep the agreement you’ll use for every check.
onboarding.step1Body: Describe the agreed scope and any limits, then save the project. We’ll compare requests with these terms.
onboarding.step2Body: Paste their message and run a check.
onboarding.step3Body: Your assessment and client reply will appear here.
onboarding.step4Body: The verdict and its rationale are here. Open Client reply to review the message.
onboarding.step5Body: Edit or copy the reply, choose its tone and language. Switch to Agreement when you need a document.
onboarding.step6Body: Prepare and edit the document here. Changes save automatically; the PDF download is below the agreement. You can switch tabs at any time.

design.firstCheckIntro: Keep the agreement, the request, and your reply in one place.

design.historyEmpty: No saved checks for this project.
design.agreementHelp: Prepare a separate proposal when the request needs additional work.
